about_the_game:
"Desting Clash" is a roguelike deck-building adventure game.

Players take on the role of the Fatebearer, commanding a diverse array of heroic warriors to fend off waves of monsters, defeating them in turn-based battles using cards.

Myths and Legends:
Recruit your champions from myths, legends, and historical figures across the world to hold back the encroaching threats!

Heroes from Europe, China, Egypt, and other regions—drawn from history and folklore—are reimagined in unique cartoon-style designs!

Hero Building:
Assemble your hero squad and crush your enemies with the tactics of Chinese generals, the curses of Egyptian pharaohs, and the divine power of European gods!

Each faction's heroes possess unique traits and mechanics—master them to overcome the relentless waves of foes!

Endless Possibilities:
With over 200 cards and a hero equipment system, no two playthroughs will ever be the same!

Spell cards, equipment cards, and hero upgrades ensure every battle offers fresh and exciting challenges!

short_description: "Desting Clash" is a roguelike card game similar to Monster Train, where you will control heroes from different countries and eras, build your deck and hero team, challenge numerous monster levels, and become the strongest Fatebearer!
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
